errors.description: The request line, path, query or a header the signature depends on could not be parsed. Also used when both header-form and presigned-form credentials are present.
No endpoint matches the path.
The path exists but not for this method. The response carries an Allow header listing the methods that do.
No credentials on a route that requires them.
The key id does not exist or is disabled.
The signature does not match. The expected value is never disclosed.
A header named in the signed-headers list is absent from the request.
The request timestamp is outside the server's skew window.
The presigned URL's expiry is in the past.
The presigned URL's expiry is further ahead than the server allows.
The key may not perform this operation on this resource. Whether the resource exists is not disclosed.
The bucket name breaks the naming rule.
The object key is empty, too long, or contains a forbidden code point.
A query parameter, header, or JSON field is present but has an invalid value or combination.
The declared part size is outside the server's limits.
The part number is below 1 or above the server's maximum.
The upload session has been completed, aborted, or has expired.
The body exceeds the applicable limit: the single-request object cap, or the session's part size.
The body ended at a different length than Content-Length declared.
The body's CRC32C does not equal the X-Tunna-Checksum header; or, at complete, a supplied per-part checksum does not equal the one recorded for that part (details.part names it).
The bucket does not exist.
The object does not exist in the bucket.
The upload session does not exist.
A bucket with this name already exists.
The bucket still contains objects or active upload sessions.
Complete was called but not every part in 1..parts has been received.
At complete, a part other than the last has a length different from the session's part size.
The server failed in a way that is not the client's fault. The response never includes internal detail.
The server is shutting down or temporarily cannot serve. Retry after a delay.
